disposition: Preparation assessment may pass with defer; no publish readiness.

walkthroughs.missing_rights_or_surface: defer; owner resolves actual evidence before publication
walkthroughs.unauthorized_publication: stop; implementation/text approvals grant no visibility/release authority
walkthroughs.post_visibility_failure: stop dependent operations; separately authorize containment; public copies cannot be recalled
walkthroughs.missing_public_reporting: keep route unverified; authorized intended-audience test still required

non_circular: CHECK-010 inspects immutable inputs and concrete runbook, not final task completion or its own result; delivery guard comes after ledger completion.
